title: Playing with his wife, Piku and Sandpaper George
summary: He played Friday and Sunday nights at the Auto Crack with his wife, Julius Piku and Sandpaper George, and tells of George's quarrel over a bass.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And I had that bass for me and my wife, and I showed my wife how to play guitar, too. She can play guitar and play my little bass, too. She can play piano and organ. Well, we used to play the Auto Crack on Fridays and Sunday. Me and my wife and Piku, Julius Piku and St. Paper George, we used to play there on Friday Sunday night. I thought we used to play there.
What happened to Sandpaper George? He'd been there.
He died. He died before, before Julius Piku died. Oh.
Did he play anything except Sandpaper?

That's all, Sandpaper. He couldn't do nothing about Sandpaper. He left one day with Aberglenny. He's dead too. Aberglenny. You were the speaker. I'm from speaker. Joseph Davis and St. Paper George. They went to Berkey. And Aberglenny had his bass. And then I was dancing in the meantime, and when they got to play, and Aberglenny had his bass. And everybody was drinking, and St. Paper George had a glass of wine, and he said, it's a shame. Everybody drink, and that full thing right there, that full energy, give him a drink. And George took a glass of wine and pulled Aberglenny's bass. And Aberglenny, he got hot. He went before Joseph Davis and the man in Hamburg. That's how fun people could tell you about that. And that's why I told Rob. But I was not there when they told me about it, you know what I mean? Yeah, it was George. Aberglenny would kill George. But that bitch, yeah.
